solitaire.name: round solitaire ring with a pave band
solitaire.traits: one ring only: a round brilliant solitaire diamond in a raised four-prong setting on a thin white-gold band; very small pave diamonds run only along the upper half of the band, from the centre stone down each shoulder, the lower half plain polished white gold; the pave as small as in the photo. The metal is cool bright silver-white white gold, never yellow or rose; the diamond colourless and icy white, never champagne or tinted.
solitaire.source: their own photo (docs/ads/gen/mn-jewelry-status/gen.py:2,23-26; same as scrollcraft/builds/mn-jewelry/src/owner/p02.jpg); first takes came out yellow gold with a tinted stone, then with stones round the whole band (blueprints mn-jewelry-status.md:138, mn-jewelry-infinity-status.md:142)

five-stone-band.name: five-stone diamond band
five-stone-band.traits: a white-gold band with exactly FIVE larger round diamonds in a single row across the top only; the rest of the band plain polished white gold with no stones; cool silver-white metal, colourless stones.
five-stone-band.source: their own photo (docs/ads/gen/mn-jewelry-infinity-status/gen.py:2-3,29-30; same as src/owner/p08.jpg); five stones counted on the photo 24 Nov 2026

twist-solitaire.name: twist solitaire ring
twist-solitaire.traits: a large round brilliant diamond in four prongs on a plain polished white-gold band that twists into the setting; no stones on the band; keep the number, cut and layout of the stones, the prongs, the band's shape and width and the metal colour; no added stones, no extra sparkle.
twist-solitaire.source: their photo chosen as the film's ring (scrollcraft/builds/mn-jewelry/CONCEPT.md:48); general traits from gen/studio-brief.md:6-7,16
